race.comment: UPSANDDOWNS (10) closed well to get up for third on debut over this distance at Murray Bridge. Less effective last time when switched back to 1000m. Draws the fence and is in the right race to bounce back to form. STOCKMAN'S CHOICE (6) returns after a ten-month break. Showed ability in the maiden prep although 1100m might be short of his best. One for the exotics. BRAVE FORTUNE (1) made a solid effort last start when resuming, beaten 1.75 lengths into third over 1100m at Bordertown. Improver who comes into calculations. MADAM MONEYBAGS (12) returns from a break. Coming along well including a win in a Strathalbyn jump-out. Expect she is primed for a big first-up performance.
